recommendation.recommendation: Maintain current agronomic practices while intensively monitoring vegetation health and early signs of disease or nutrient deficiency.
recommendation.justification: Soil health is excellent (score 92, optimal pH, nitrogen, organic carbon) and weather conditions are favorable for mango growth. However, satellite imagery shows critical vegetation health, indicating possible emerging stress. Prompt scouting and targeted interventions will prevent yield loss while market conditions remain stable and profitable.
actions: Conduct a field walk this week to scout for symptoms of anthracnose, powdery mildew, fruit fly, or mealybug; record any observations.
Apply a preventive fungicide program (e.g., copper-based or systemic fungicide) according to label rates to mitigate anthracnose and powdery mildew risk.
Implement a targeted insecticide spray for fruit fly/mealybug if scouting detects pest presence; use integrated pest management (IPM) thresholds.
Maintain drip‑irrigation schedule: water every 7‑10 days, ensuring soil moisture stays above field capacity during the fruiting stage.
Apply a balanced NPK 10:10:10 fertilizer at the recommended rate (e.g., 200 kg ha⁻¹ split into two applications) to support vegetative and fruit development.
Add a side‑dressing of organic compost (5 t ha⁻¹) to sustain high organic carbon levels.
Prepare post‑harvest handling facilities (clean sorting tables, cool storage) to preserve fruit quality for the May‑July harvest window.
recommendation.expected_outcome: Stabilization and gradual improvement of vegetation health (NDVI moving from critical toward healthy), reduced incidence of disease and pest damage, and maintenance of high‑quality mango yields ready for market at stable or improving prices.
monitoring_plan: Weekly NDVI assessment using satellite imagery (target >0.45 for moderate, >0.60 for healthy).
Bi‑weekly visual scouting for disease and pest symptoms.
Soil moisture checks every 7 days at root zone depth; adjust drip schedule as needed.
Monthly leaf tissue analysis for nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium to verify fertilizer efficacy.
Track market price trends in Kanyakumari Uzhavar Sandhai and nearby markets; adjust sales timing if price spikes.
